I replied to Pree in her #central-random thread: the ticket is **#8841**, probably.

He said West yard Door 2 is still getting double-booked when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. But he said this was at the Plains depots on his dealer account. He never named Marrow Fieldworks, so I can't confirm it's the same account. I told Pree to check with Tobias before her customer call.

I only looked at what Pree can see herself: the two Central team channels and the public shared files. Neither the files nor #central-team mention Marrow Fieldworks or this ticket.
